findings.finding: The completion condition of the last milestone names no command; it defers to benchmarks the plan does not identify, so no run can say it is met.
findings.evidence: done_when[3].condition "declared only when lines 6, 7, 8 and 10 of r4 are measured against the benchmarks the operator fixed"
findings.what_changes_if_true: The milestone cannot be closed by a check and stays open until the operator names the benchmark commands.

findings.finding: The proof of S1-06 records a time but names no command that produces or compares it.
findings.evidence: fronts[1].tasks[5].proof "Time recorded; target PRF-001 below 10 s."
findings.what_changes_if_true: Segment 1 can be declared green on a time nobody can reproduce.

findings.finding: Front 1 builds against bridge seg1, which the situation lists as proposed, not ratified; the front does not say it waits for that authorization.
findings.what_changes_if_true: Front 1 must wait for D0-02 or it runs on an unauthorized mandate.
